subject.title: Improve read tool handling for binary document formats (.docx, .pdf, .pptx, .xlsx) & Avoid Token Waste on Binary Read

question: Should the read tool get a narrow core safe-fallback guard for binary document formats now, or should this wait for broader document parsing/provider-native file input work?
rationale: The source-proven problem is narrow, but automatic parsing and provider-native forwarding overlap with larger open document-input issues and plugin/ClawHub scope decisions.

options.title: Add narrow read fallback
options.body: Keep the fix small: detect PDF/Office-style binary documents before text decoding and return a clear instruction to use pdf or a document parser.

options.title: Fold into broader document input
options.body: Defer this issue to the provider-native file/document and attachment ingestion design so read behavior changes only once.

options.title: Implement parsing in core
options.body: Add native extraction for selected formats in the read path, accepting the larger dependency, security, and maintenance surface.

recommendation.title: Add narrow read fallback
recommendation.body: Keep the fix small: detect PDF/Office-style binary documents before text decoding and return a clear instruction to use pdf or a document parser.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans read-tool behavior and existing media/PDF tool boundaries, where vincentkoc has the strongest adjacent history in the evidence gathered.
